title: Skills for Real Engineers
description: 从需求澄清到实现与验证，把工程经验带进 Agent 协作。
overview: 把日常工程工作拆成可组合的小 Skills，覆盖需求澄清、方案整理、任务拆分、代码实现、测试与审查，也包括故障诊断和项目维护。本合集完整收录作者 engineering、misc、productivity 三个目录组，不包含 in-progress 中的试验项；不等同于作者的 Claude Code 插件安装包。
usage: 每个项目首次使用时，先让 Agent 完成项目配置，再按阶段选择需求澄清、实现、测试或评审；拿不准时可用 ask-matt 找到合适的能力。

evidence.title: Skills For Real Engineers
evidence.finding: 作者说明这些 Skills 用于日常工程工作，可组合使用；README 定义 Engineering 和 Productivity 两组，并说明项目首次配置方式。本证据不宣称存在作者官方定义的 31 项安装包。

evidence.title: Misc skills
evidence.location: skills/misc/README.md；skills/misc/ 四个 Skill 目录
evidence.finding: 作者单独定义 Misc 目录，当前四项来自此组；Misc 不属于 Claude Code 插件清单。本合集把该组与另外两组一并收录，范围须在接入前确认。

notes: 保留官网现有固定 commit 和全部条目；本轮核对原作者说明、目录树与仓库根许可证，摘要沿用现有中文用途说明。
安装项引用仓库根 MIT 许可证；完整资源范围、可能的单独许可与安装兼容性尚未逐项复核，也未安装或运行第三方 Skills。
原项目封面用于记录现有素材，图片的具体使用授权仍待确认；批准发布时未解决则使用概念封面。
固定提交共 37 个入口；本记录只覆盖上述三个目录中的 31 项，排除 in-progress 的 6 项。官方插件为 27 项；这里不把 31 项宣称为作者官方安装包。
用户明确批准将现有官网展示内容接入统一 JSON 结构；此次仅批准展示迁移，保留现有来源、文件、素材与安装核验状态。

en.title: Skills for Real Engineers
en.description: Bring engineering practice into agent collaboration, from clarifying requirements to implementation and verification.
en.overview: Composable Skills for everyday engineering work: clarifying requirements, shaping plans, breaking down tasks, implementation, testing, and review, as well as debugging and project maintenance. This collection includes all Skills in the author's engineering, misc, and productivity groups. It excludes experimental items in in-progress and differs from the author's Claude Code plugin package.
en.usage: For a project's first use, ask the agent to configure the project. Then choose requirement clarification, implementation, testing, or review for the current stage. Use ask-matt if you are unsure which Skill fits.
en.coverAlt: Original Skills for Real Engineers project cover

engineering-readme.title: Skills For Real Engineers
engineering-readme.location: README.md / Installation / Reference / Engineering and Productivity
engineering-readme.finding: The author describes these Skills as composable tools for everyday engineering. The README defines the Engineering and Productivity groups and explains initial project setup. This evidence does not establish an official package of 31 Skills.

engineering-misc-readme.title: Misc skills
engineering-misc-readme.location: skills/misc/README.md and the four Skill directories under skills/misc/
engineering-misc-readme.finding: The author defines a separate Misc directory containing these four items. Misc is not part of the Claude Code plugin list. This collection combines it with the other two groups; the scope still needs confirmation before integration.

ask-matt.summary: Recommend a suitable Skill or workflow from this repository for the current problem.

setup-matt-pocock-skills.summary: Configure the issue tracker, triage labels, and domain document layout for the engineering Skills.

grill-me.summary: Refine an existing plan or design through sustained, detailed questioning.

to-spec.summary: Synthesize the discussion into a specification and publish it to the project's issue tracker.

implement-spec.summary: Implement the results of the specification and task breakdown workflows in code.

tdd.summary: Develop features or fix bugs with tests first, including integration tests.

code-review.summary: Review coding standards and requirement compliance in parallel, presenting the two results side by side.

diagnosing-bugs.summary: Diagnose difficult bugs and performance regressions to trace failures or slow behavior.

codebase-design.summary: Improve module interfaces, boundaries, and testability using deep-module design principles.

domain-modeling.summary: Organize domain terminology and maintain a glossary and architecture decision records.

grill-with-docs.summary: Refine plans through detailed questioning while documenting architecture decisions and domain terms.

implement.summary: Implement a piece of work from an existing specification or task list.

improve-codebase-architecture.summary: Identify module improvement opportunities, present a visual report, and discuss a selected approach in detail.

pr.summary: Turn development changes into a description for a pull request.

prototype.summary: Use a throwaway prototype to explore a design question, state logic, or interface behavior.

research.summary: Consult trusted primary sources and save the findings as a document in the project.

retro.summary: Review a coding session's process and practices in a retrospective.

to-tickets.summary: Break a plan into incrementally deliverable tasks and record their blocking relationships.

triage.summary: Classify and verify issues and external pull requests, preparing briefs that agents can act on.

wayfinder.summary: Map a large effort into shared decision tasks and clarify the path to the goal one decision at a time.

wizard.summary: Generate an interactive command-line wizard for setup or migration steps that a human must perform.

git-guardrails-claude-code.summary: Set up Claude Code safety hooks to block dangerous Git commands before execution.

migrate-to-shoehorn.summary: Migrate type assertions in tests to shoehorn for constructing partial test data.

scaffold-exercises.summary: Create exercise directories with sections, problems, solutions, and explanations that pass checks.

setup-pre-commit.summary: Configure pre-commit hooks to run formatting, type checks, and tests automatically.

grilling.summary: Question a plan, decision, or idea in depth to test the reasoning behind it.

handoff.summary: Condense the current conversation into a handoff document so another agent can continue the work.

teach.summary: Teach the user a new Skill or concept in the current workspace.

to-questionnaire.summary: Turn a decision that cannot yet be fully answered into a questionnaire for someone else.

wait-what.summary: Pause when the previous message was misunderstood, then reorganize and explain it again.

writing-for-agents.summary: Write documentation for agents, including Skill files and project collaboration rules.
